title: Automating Feature Flag Cleanup at Scale with Multi-Agent LLM Systems: An Industrial Experience at DoorDash
title_zh: 用多智能体LLM系统大规模自动化功能开关清理：DoorDash的工业实践

paragraphs.en: DoorDash用多智能体LLM系统自动化清理过期功能开关，90%成功率，每次仅需4.79美元和13.8分钟。 Feature flags are runtime configuration mechanisms used for gradual feature rollouts, experimentation, and kill switches. Once a feature is fully rolled out, the flag and its gated code become technical debt and can introduce operational risk through inadvertently enabling dormant code paths. At DoorDash, over 56,000 feature flags span 623 repositories, with 1,659 currently stale as of May 2026, with internal estimates of one to two hours per manual cleanup. Existing rule-based cleanup tools proved insufficient in DoorDash's codebases. Our contribution is an end-to-end automated LLM-based feature flag cleanup system that integrates querying live feature flag rollout data using MCP, Jira ticket processing, and end-to-end pull request creation. Our system successfully produced engineer-approved flag removal PRs for 45 (90%) of the 50 stale flags it was evaluated on, proving the system's operational viability at scale with each cleanup averaging only $4.79 and 13.8 minutes. We evaluated the system's quality and reliability boundary based on success rates, cost per cleanup and time metrics. Furthermore, we discuss our lessons learned when architecting this system, to provide practical guidance for developing similar multi-agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: DoorDash 用多智能体 LLM 系统自动化清理过期功能开关，成功率达 90%，每次仅需 4.79 美元和 13.8 分钟。功能开关（feature flags）是用于渐进式功能发布、实验和紧急开关的运行时配置机制。 一旦功能完全发布，该开关及其门控的代码就会成为技术债务，并可能因无意中启用休眠的代码路径而引入运维风险。 在 DoorDash，超过 56,000 个功能开关分布在 623 个代码仓库中，截至 2026 年 5 月，其中 1,659 个处于过期状态，内部估计每次人工清理需要一到两个小时。 现有的基于规则的清理工具在 DoorDash 的代码库中被证明不够有效。 我们的贡献是一个端到端自动化的基于 LLM 的功能开关清理系统，它集成了使用 MCP 查询实时功能开关发布数据、Jira 工单处理以及端到端的拉取请求创建。 该系统在评估的 50 个过期功能开关中，成功生成了 45 个（90%）获得工程师认可的删除开关的拉取请求，证明了该系统在大规模场景下的运营可行性，每次清理平均仅需 4.79 美元和 13.8 分钟。 我们基于成功率、每次清理的成本和时间指标，评估了该系统的质量与可靠性边界。 此外，我们讨论了在构建该系统过程中获得的经验教训，为开发类似的多智能体系统提供实践指导。
